settings.heading: Returns and exchanges
settings.text: Seven days from delivery. One size exchange per order is free. No forms to print.

settings.title: 1 · Raise it
settings.text: Reply to your order email or use the returns link in your account, within 7 days of delivery.

settings.title: 2 · We collect
settings.text: A pickup is scheduled within 48 hours across serviceable PIN codes. Keep the tags on.

settings.title: 3 · Money back
settings.text: Refunds land in 5 to 7 working days to the original method. COD orders refund to your bank.

settings.question: What cannot be returned?
settings.answer: Innerwear, socks and anything worn, washed or missing its tags. Marked-down clearance pieces are exchange only.

settings.question: Is the exchange really free?
settings.answer: One size exchange per order, yes. Additional exchanges carry a ₹99 logistics fee.

settings.question: My PIN code is not serviceable for pickup.
settings.answer: Ship it to us and we reimburse the courier cost up to ₹150 with a receipt.

settings.question: Can I return in store?
settings.answer: Yes, at any BANISHQ floor within seven days, with the order confirmation on your phone.
